request.recipient: Dano Finance, with Minswap Labs serving as budget administrator
request.what: Dano Finance requests treasury funding to accelerate the DeFi Kernel as an open standard for shared liquidity, on-chain financial intents, and global order-book coordination on Cardano, including registry work, two DeFi primitives, and an SDK.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,333,000 ADA total, with 3,300,000 ADA for delivery and 33,000 ADA for Minswap Labs' 1% budget administration fee.
Dano Finance says the funded work will deliver a public DeFi Kernel registry, a Spot Leverage Order Book, an American Options market-making protocol, and a Composable DeFi Transaction Builder SDK.
The proposal asserts that Cardano DeFi is fragmented across liquidity, metadata, and execution paths, limiting integrations, market depth, and advanced financial applications.

The DeFi Kernel registry is intended to publish smart contract metadata such as script hashes, datum and redeemer schemas, integration steps, audit or security status, TVL references, and discovery mechanisms.
Dano Finance claims it currently has approximately USD 18M in TVL and more than 10,000 on-chain transactions.

The Spot Leverage Order Book work package is budgeted at 1,000,000 ADA and is intended to deliver leveraged spot trading with collateral, borrowing, debt accounting, position management, risk parameters, and settlement.
The American Options Protocol work package is budgeted at 1,000,000 ADA and is intended to deliver an American options market-making protocol using an extended concentrated-pool model.
The SDK work package is budgeted at 1,000,000 ADA and is intended to support registry metadata reading, discovery, transaction construction, adapters, examples, tests, and integration documentation.

The proposal sets KPIs including mainnet deployments after security review, USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day trading volume for the order book within 90 days of launch, USD 1,000,000 rolling 30-day options notional volume within 90 days of launch, and at least one external SDK integration started or completed.

Dano Finance says it will return 5% of protocol fees generated by the treasury-funded Spot Leverage Order Book and American Options contracts for 12 months after mainnet launch, after specified direct costs, with public reporting.

summary: The anchor describes a 3,333,000 ADA treasury request for Dano Finance, administered by Minswap Labs, to build DeFi Kernel registry infrastructure, two DeFi protocols, and an SDK, with milestones, KPIs, security-review conditions, reporting, and a limited protocol-fee return commitment.
